purpose: One entry per model family. The runner reads the flags from here instead of relying on prose, so an agent picks a profile instead of reproducing model exceptions from memory.

profile_fields.binary: Which llama.cpp copy to use: active (785322d17) or legacy pin (d4cff114c).
profile_fields.flags: Exact llama-hidden-states flags. -b/-ub are never passed: batch mode sets them from --max-len.
profile_fields.inputs: pilot/main question files. If builder is set, the runner runs it first and uses built.
profile_fields.prompt_expectation: What hs-prompt-dump must report. A mismatch stops the run.
profile_fields.pilot_gate: Thresholds for pipeline/gate_report.py. Overrides the defaults.
profile_fields.meta_postprocessor: Optional named postprocessor run after extraction and before the gate.
profile_fields.blocked: Non-null means the stage refuses to run without -ConfirmDeferred.

standard.description: Any GGUF whose stock chat template works and which fits VRAM. Use it only when no family profile below matches.

prompt_expectation.note: Check the dump by eye: the prompt must contain one instruction and the reported add_bos must match llama_vocab_get_add_bos for the model.

notes: If add_bos=1 and the first token is not the BOS id, stop: the prompt lost <bos> and the run would repeat the Gemma 4 12B incident.

qwen.description: Qwen 3.5 family (0.8B / 2B / 4B) in Q4_K_M from unsloth.
notes: add_bos_token is false for Qwen, so the 2026-11-02 BOS fix does not change these prompts.

qwen9b.description: Qwen 3.5 9B Q4_K_M: 5.68 GB, fits 6 GB VRAM only with -ngl 99 (peak 5860 MiB).
notes: Do not lower -ngl: 30/26/22 give 1.96/1.31/1.01 ex/s against 2.90 for 99.
Auto-fit refuses this model (n_gpu_layers already set), but -ngl 99 works.
Write stdout/stderr to a file. Piping through Tee-Object made the 9B pilot three times slower.

gemma.description: Gemma 4 E2B / E4B with the stock chat template. add_bos_token is true.
notes: Do not compare a new BOS run token-for-token with main_gemma4e2b or main_gemma4e4b: those lack <bos>.
The chat template prints <bos> and llama.cpp strips it, expecting the tokenizer to add it back. The dump must show first token 2.

yandex.description: YandexGPT 5 Lite 8B Instruct, arch llama, Q4_K_M.

nemotron.description: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B, hybrid arch nemotron_h. Only 17 of 42 layers emit l_out.
notes: --layers all is correct: the binary probes l_out and drops layers without it. Expect 'selected layers after l_out probe: 17 of 42'.
verify_run.py reports warns=1 for the pruning. That is expected, not a defect.
17 zero layers or skipped rows mean the old broken binary. Stop and check --version.

gptoss20b.description: gpt-oss-20b MXFP4. Reasoning flags do not work in this tool, so the harmony prompt is pre-filled with the final channel and run with --no-template.

prompt_expectation.note: Point A is the last token of the pre-filled final channel, not <|start|>assistant. This is intentional.

notes: -ngl 12+ spills to shared memory and is 2.3-2.9x slower; 11 is the optimum (2.71 s/row, 5.79 GB peak).
The instruction 'Answer with just the answer, no explanation.' must appear exactly once in the built prompt. The duplicated-instruction run main_gptoss20b_dupinstr is invalid.
Never run this profile without --no-template.

lfm25-2.6b.description: LFM2.5-2.6B. The stock template opens  thinking even when thinking is false, so the input ends with 'Final answer:' and runs with --no-template.

prompt_expectation.note: Point A is the last token of 'Final answer:'.

notes: The builder must be idempotent: rebuilding data/pilot_lfm25_final.jsonl from data/pilot.jsonl must give a byte-identical file.
128 truncated and 138 null rows of 6000 in the reference run; that is accepted for this model.

lfm25-1.2b-thinking.description: LFM2.5-1.2B Thinking: fixed 32-token reasoning, forced final cue, 64-token final pass, then state replay.
notes: Protocol: docs/LFM25-THINKING-PROTOCOL.md.
Run scripts/prepare_lfm_thinking.ps1 for pilot/main before scripts/run.ps1.
A is post-reasoning at the Final answer: cue; C is the last token of extracted final.

lfm3.description: LFM3-1.7B QAD Q4. Stock no-thinking prompt is correct, but 41.8% of rows do not finish within 64 tokens.

blocked.reason: Only a cheap llama-cli diagnostic (temp=0.1, top_k=50, repeat_penalty=1.1 vs raw argmax) was proposed. Do not launch another 6000-row run before it.

notes: The reference run is usable only for the 3491 completed rows; every metric carries that restriction.

gemma4-12b-kaggle.description: Gemma 4 12B on Kaggle (2 x T4). Not runnable on the local 6 GB GPU.

blocked.reason: Kaggle GPU hours are limited to 30 per week. Run the pilot, estimate the budget, report the quota, and get an explicit request before a full 6000-row session.

notes: Workflow: kaggle/gemma4_12b/push.ps1, then kaggle/watch.ps1, then kaggle kernels output into a new version directory.
Probe for main_gemma4_12b_v3 was computed locally on 2026-11-04 (lambda 3000, C/28, test 0.9107); probe2 matched byte-for-byte.
The local runner does not drive Kaggle; use run.ps1 only for verify/baseline/probe on a downloaded directory.

gemma4-26b-a4b-kaggle.description: Gemma 4 26B-A4B on Kaggle (2 x T4). Not runnable on the local 6 GB GPU.

blocked.reason: Kaggle GPU hours are limited. Run the pilot, estimate the budget, report the quota, and get an explicit request before a full 6000-row session.

notes: Workflow: kaggle/gemma4_26b_a4b/push.ps1, then Kaggle status/output into a new version directory.
The v2 run passed its gate and structural validation: 6000/6000 rows, 32 truncated, shape [6000,30,2816].
